errors.INVALID_INPUT: The return details are invalid. Check them and try again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to process returns.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This return needs a manager's approval.
errors.APPROVAL_INVALID: The manager approval is invalid or expired. Ask for it again.
errors.SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: No shift is open. Open a shift before processing a return.
errors.SALE_NOT_COMPLETED: This sale was voided, so it cannot be returned.
errors.TOO_MANY_LINES: Too many lines in one return.
errors.UNKNOWN_LINE: The selected item is not part of this sale.
errors.INVALID_QUANTITY: The return quantity is invalid. Pieces must be returned in whole units.
errors.ALREADY_REFUNDED: This item has already been returned in full.
errors.OVER_REFUND: The quantity or amount exceeds what is left to return.
errors.REASON_NOTE_REQUIRED: A note is required when the reason is "Other".
errors.NOT_SUPPORTED: Returning gift cards or store credit is not available yet.
errors.REFUND_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The money cannot be returned this way. Card and QPay can only be returned to the original method.
errors.PAYMENT_MISMATCH: The refund payments do not add up to the refund total.
errors.CASH_NOT_IN_UNITS: The cash amount must be a multiple of the smallest cash unit.
errors.ALLOCATION_FAILED: The refund cannot be split across the original payment methods. Ask a manager.
errors.REFUND_WINDOW_EXCEEDED: The return window has passed. A manager's approval is required.
errors.EXCHANGE_INVALID: The exchange is invalid. Check the replacement items.
errors.EXCHANGE_MISMATCH: The replacement sale total does not match. Refresh the cart.
errors.TOTAL_MISMATCH: The refund total has changed. Review it and continue.
errors.PAYMENT_PROVIDER_FAILED: The payment provider could not return the money. Nothing was refunded. Try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This return was already recorded with different content. Start a new one.
errors.CONCURRENT_DUPLICATE: Another request is processing this return. Wait a moment and check.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong while processing the return. Try again.

errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to void sales.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Voiding a sale needs a manager's approval.
errors.APPROVAL_INVALID: The manager approval is invalid or expired. Ask for it again.
errors.SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: No shift is open. A sale can only be voided in an open shift.
errors.VOID_NOT_ALLOWED: This sale cannot be voided. The payment provider may have refused.
errors.ALREADY_VOIDED: This sale has already been voided.
errors.ALREADY_REFUNDED: A sale with returns cannot be voided.
errors.SALE_IN_OTHER_SHIFT: A sale from another shift cannot be voided. Process a return instead.
errors.REASON_NOTE_REQUIRED: A note is required when the reason is "Other".
errors.NOT_SUPPORTED: Voiding sales paid with gift cards or store credit is not available yet.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This sale was already voided with different details.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong while voiding. Try again.

errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This action needs a manager's approval.
errors.APPROVAL_INVALID: The manager approval is invalid or expired. Ask for it again.
errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_OPEN: A shift is already open on this register.
errors.DENOMINATIONS_INVALID: The denomination counts are invalid. Check and enter them again.
errors.VARIANCE_NOTE_REQUIRED: The cash variance is large. Add a note.
errors.CLOSE_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: Too many failed attempts to close this shift. A manager must close it.
errors.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.AMOUNT_NOT_IN_UNITS: The amount must be a multiple of the smallest denomination.
errors.PAYOUT_EXCEEDS_CASH: The pay-out is more than the cash in the drawer. A manager's approval is required.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This entry was already recorded with different content.
